concerns.text: Task T012f (Fetch large-scale log dataset) is marked incomplete [ ]. The plan.md Phase 4 (Scalability Benchmark) and T045a explicitly depend on `data/raw/agent_logs.csv` from this task. Without a completed task to fetch/generate this data, the benchmark element of the plan and the US-03 scalability validation cannot be executed. The task description notes it is 'Required for T045a' but provides no fallback or alternative path to satisfy the plan element.

US-02 Acceptance Criteria 3 requires 'Human annotations are ingested'. Task T035-real-human is marked OPTIONAL [ ], and T035-real-generate creates a *simulated* dataset. While T035-real-human-verify exists, the lack of a mandatory task to ingest real human annotations (or a defined alternative that satisfies Constitution Principle VI) means the 'Human-in-the-Loop' element of the plan and the US-02 success criteria cannot be fully satisfied as written. The current tasks allow the pipeline to pass with only simulated data, which contradicts the 'Human-annotated gold standard' requirement in the Constitution.

Task T025b (Final Statistical Validation) is marked incomplete [ ]. It depends on T021d and T017. While T025a (Initial Statistical Validation) is marked complete, T025b is required to handle the conditional logic for real vs. proxy data for the final US-01 validation gate (T026b). The absence of a completed task for T025b leaves the final validation logic for US-01 unimplemented in the task list.

Task T039-gpt-final (Final Baseline Run) is marked incomplete [ ]. It is required for T041-final (Final Comparison Report) and T042b (Efficiency Gate). The task description states it will 'fail if missing' real human data, but T035-real-human is optional. This creates a gap where the US-03 baseline comparison cannot be completed with the required data source, and no alternative task is defined to satisfy the US-03 acceptance criteria (AUC comparison) in the absence of real human data.

Tasks T056 (Final Report Generation), T057 (Reproducibility Audit), and T058 (Data Lineage Verification) are all marked incomplete [ ]. These tasks correspond to the 'Final Review & Reporting' phase in the plan and are necessary to satisfy the 'Single Source of Truth' and 'Versioning Discipline' principles of the Constitution. Their absence means the project cannot produce the required final artifacts (report, audit, lineage) to close the project.

Task T030a-Stratify uses the marker '[deferred]' for binning thresholds ('top [deferred] and bottom [deferred]'). While '[deferred]' is a sanctioned marker for empirical values, the task description does not specify *which* metric or reference defines these thresholds (e.g., 'top 10% of drift scores'). The spec and plan also lack this specific definition. This makes the task description ambiguous and the resulting binning non-deterministic until the specific quantile values are defined in the spec or plan.
